name: Datashift
verdict: Datashift is a Belgian data and AI consultancy founded in 2015, led by co-founder/CEO Nico Huybrechts, with private-equity firm Finco onboard as partner. Nothing found.
note: Mechelen consultancy; joined the AG Insurance-Soudal 2026 jersey as new partner (team kit launch, 2025-12-17). Rating note: ownership documented (claim datashift-ownership); Finco's exact stake is not published in the sources checked. No relevant record found.
